B: KEY=180000 20000
B: SW=22

N: Name="Intel HID switches"

B: SW=2

description: falls back to a combined tablet switch

B: SW=1

N: Name="hotkeys"

B: KEY=1
B: SW=2

devices:
N: Name="first"

devices:
